intro.text: Lead Tax Group Inc. values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and disclose personal information when you use our website, software, and services.
By using Lead Tax, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

blocks.text: Lead Tax Inc. provides online, do-it-yourself personal tax filing services for Canadian residents. Our platform is powered by CRA NETFILE-certified software using the CloudTax API, allowing users to prepare and file tax returns securely and accurately with the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA).
We collect only the information necessary to provide tax filing services and support you effectively.
Personal Information You Provide
This may include:

items: Name, address, email address, phone number
Date of birth and Social Insurance Number (SIN)
Marital and family status
Employment, income, and tax-related information
Uploaded tax slips and documents
Payment and billing information

blocks.text: Automatically Collected Information
When you use our website or platform, we may collect:

items: IP address and browser type
Device and usage data
Pages visited and actions taken on the site
Cookies and similar tracking technologies

blocks.text: This information helps us improve performance, security, and user experience.
We use your information to:

items: Prepare and file your tax return with the CRA
Calculate taxes accurately and apply eligible credits
Provide phone and email support
Respond to inquiries and CRA notices
Process payments and prevent fraud
Improve our services and user experience
Meet legal and regulatory requirements

blocks.text: We do not sell your personal information.
Lead Tax uses CRA NETFILE-certified software powered by the CloudTax API to prepare and submit tax returns.
This means:

items: Your return is transmitted securely to the CRA
All calculations follow CRA rules and validation checks
CloudTax acts as a technology service provider and does not use your data for unrelated purposes
Your tax data is used only to deliver the services you request.

blocks.text: Lead Tax experts may access your information only when necessary to:

items: Provide support you request
Resolve technical or filing issues
Assist with CRA inquiries or corrections

blocks.text: All staff and contractors are bound by confidentiality obligations and access controls.

sections.title: 6. How We Store and Protect Your Information

blocks.text: We use industry-standard security measures to protect your information, including:

items: Encrypted data transmission
Secure cloud infrastructure hosted in Canada
Role-based access controls
Ongoing monitoring and security reviews

blocks.text: We retain personal information only as long as required to provide services or meet legal obligations.
We may share your information only in the following limited circumstances:

items: With the CRA for tax filing and compliance
With service providers that help us operate our platform (such as payment processors), under strict confidentiality agreements
When required by law, court order, or regulatory authority

blocks.text: We do not share your information for marketing purposes with third parties.
Lead Tax uses cookies and similar technologies to:

items: Keep you signed in
Improve website performance
Understand how users interact with our platform

blocks.text: You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.
You have the right to:

items: Access your personal information
Request corrections to inaccurate data
Withdraw consent where permitted by law
Request information about how your data is used

blocks.text: Some requests may be limited due to legal or CRA requirements.
Lead Tax services are not intended for children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors without parental consent.

Certain filings are not supported through Lead Tax DIY. In these cases, personal information may be used only if you choose to proceed through our File Remotely or in-person services, and only with your consent.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on our website with an updated revision date.
Continued use of our services after updates means you accept the revised policy.
